parts.html: The K-02 kitchen from our standard range is L-shaped, with an island, in beige tones and a minimalist style. The upper fronts are veneered, the lower ones painted, and the countertop is porcelain stoneware: natural wood above, a solid color below.
The corner section holds cabinets, built-in appliances, and the main cooking zone. The island adds a second work surface in the middle of the kitchen.
The wall cabinets open on FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanisms, the doors hang on Hettich soft-close hinges, and the drawers run on the AvanTech YOU Hettich system.
We redesign the K-02 for your room, taking into account its dimensions, utility connections, and the appliances you choose, then manufacture and install it in Bratislava or Vienna.
